name: The accounting equation
expression: Assets = liabilities + equity
inputs: Assets: recognized resources at the reporting date.
Liabilities: recognized obligations at that date.
Equity: residual interest after liabilities.
scope: The concatenated source also contains a minus sign conflicting with its own accounting identity. The reviewed identity uses addition.

name: Balance-sheet and retained-earnings checks
expression: Assets = liabilities + equity; closing retained earnings = opening retained earnings + attributable profit − distributions ± applicable adjustments
units: currency at a date / over a period
inputs: Opening retained earnings: prior closing balance.
Attributable profit: earnings belonging to the relevant owners.
Distributions and adjustments: dividends and other applicable movements.
scope: The source omits distributions and adjustments from its retained-earnings shorthand. A balanced equation does not establish correct recognition.

name: Debt-to-equity
expression: Total debt / total equity
inputs: Total debt: borrowings under the declared debt definition.
Total equity: equity on the matching consolidated/entity basis.
scope: Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Debt-to-assets
expression: Total debt / total assets
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Total debt: the chosen borrowing measure, not automatically all liabilities.
Total assets: recognized assets at the matching reporting date.
scope: Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Current ratio
expression: Current assets / current liabilities
inputs: Current assets: assets classified as current.
Current liabilities: obligations classified as current.
scope: Classification and realizability matter; compare like business models and dates. Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Equity multiplier
expression: Total assets / total equity
inputs: Total assets: recognized asset base.
Total equity: equity on the same entity and date basis.
scope: Non-equity funding includes liabilities beyond interest-bearing debt. For DuPont, use compatible averages.

name: Quick ratio
expression: (Current assets − inventory − prepayments − other non-quick current assets) / current liabilities
inputs: Quick assets: cash, eligible liquid investments and collectible receivables under the stated definition.
Current liabilities: matching short-term obligations.
scope: The source’s assets-minus-inventory shortcut assumes the remaining assets are quick. State exclusions and receivable quality.

name: Cash ratio
expression: Cash and cash equivalents / current liabilities
inputs: Cash and equivalents: eligible cash balances and cash equivalents.
Current liabilities: matching short-term obligations.
scope: State restrictions on cash and any different convention for liquid investments. Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Net working capital
expression: Current assets − current liabilities
inputs: Current assets: current balance-sheet assets.
Current liabilities: current balance-sheet obligations.
scope: This broad balance-sheet measure differs from noncash operating working capital used in valuation. Negative working capital is not automatically distress.

name: Net working capital to total assets
expression: (Current assets − current liabilities) / total assets
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Net working capital: current assets less current liabilities.
Total assets: the matching recognized asset base.
scope: This measures working capital relative to total assets, not the current ratio.

name: Debt-to-capitalisation
expression: Debt / (debt + equity)
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Debt: borrowings under the declared convention.
Equity: a compatible book or market equity value.
scope: Do not mix book debt and market equity without stating the purpose and convention. Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Return on assets
expression: Net income / average total assets
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Net income: attributable earnings for the selected entity/period.
Average assets: preferably time-weighted assets; opening/closing mean is a shortcut.
scope: Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Return on equity
expression: Attributable net income / average corresponding equity
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Attributable income: earnings matching the equity owners being measured.
Average corresponding equity: compatible average owner capital.
scope: Match common versus total-shareholder earnings and equity. Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Total asset turnover
expression: Net sales / average total assets
inputs: Net sales: period sales after relevant returns/allowances.
Average total assets: assets used over the same period.
scope: The source subtracts assets from sales. Turnover divides period sales by the asset base.

name: Receivables turnover
expression: Net credit sales / average trade receivables
inputs: Net credit sales: sales creating the receivables being measured.
Average trade receivables: matching collectible customer balance.
scope: Use compatible sales tax, credit/cash sales and receivable definitions.

name: Payables turnover
expression: Credit purchases / average trade payables
inputs: Credit purchases: purchases creating the supplier liability.
Average trade payables: matching supplier balance.
scope: The source says total supplier purchases. Cost of sales is only a disclosed proxy when appropriate.

name: Inventory turnover
expression: Cost of goods sold / average inventory
inputs: COGS: cost of the stock sold over the period.
Average inventory: matching stock on a consistent valuation basis.
scope: Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Fixed-asset turnover
expression: Revenue / average net fixed assets
inputs: Revenue: compatible period sales.
Average net fixed assets: carrying values of productive fixed assets over the period.
scope: The source uses net fixed assets without averaging. A closing-base convention must be disclosed; asset age and leasing affect comparisons.

name: Liabilities to adjusted tangible net worth
expression: Total liabilities / (equity − intangibles − prepayments − related-party receivables)
inputs: Total liabilities: the declared obligation base.
Adjusted tangible net worth: equity after the listed deductions.
scope: This is the source’s lender-style adjustment, not a universal net-worth definition. Contract definitions and a positive denominator are essential.

name: Market value of equity
expression: Shares outstanding × market price per share
inputs: Shares outstanding: shares on the compatible share-class basis.
Market price: price for that class at the valuation date.
scope: Multiple share classes and other equity claims can require separate valuation.

name: Market-to-book equity
expression: Market capitalisation / book equity
inputs: Market capitalisation: market value of the corresponding equity.
Book equity: corresponding accounting equity.
scope: Match owners and date; negative book equity limits interpretation.

name: Simplified enterprise value
expression: Equity market value + debt − cash
inputs: Equity value: compatible market value.
Debt: relevant debt claims.
Cash: eligible cash adjustment.
scope: Preferred equity, non-controlling interests and other claims/adjustments may be required. This is a simplified bridge.

name: Bank total-capital adequacy
expression: (Eligible Tier 1 capital + eligible Tier 2 capital) / risk-weighted assets × 100
inputs: Eligible regulatory capital: capital recognized under the applicable regime.
Risk-weighted assets: the regime’s risk-weighted denominator.
scope: This is regulatory capital coverage, not cash liquidity. No current threshold, buffer or compliance conclusion is supplied.

name: Price-to-book
expression: Market price per share / book equity per corresponding share
inputs: Market price: matching share-class price.
Book equity per share: equity allocated to that class divided by its relevant shares.
scope: Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Cash-balance reconciliation
expression: Closing cash = opening cash + operating + investing + financing cash flows + applicable reconciling effects
inputs: Opening/closing cash: balances on a consistent cash definition.
Activity cash flows: signed inflows less outflows.
Reconciling effects: applicable exchange-rate and other reconciliation items.
scope: The source’s three-flow bridge is simplified; include material required reconciling effects.

name: Indirect operating-cash-flow bridge
expression: Net income + signed noncash adjustments − increase in noncash operating working capital + other required operating reconciliations
inputs: Signed noncash adjustments: add noncash charges and remove applicable gains/items.
Increase in operating working capital: investment in noncash operating balances.
scope: Framework and interest/tax classifications matter. CAPEX is cash capital expenditure expressed as a positive outflow; ΔNWC is an increase in noncash operating working capital, excluding financing debt. Reconcile classification and other noncash/operating adjustments.

name: Operating cash flow less capital expenditure
expression: Operating cash flow − cash CAPEX
inputs: OCF: reported operating cash flow on the declared basis.
Cash CAPEX: cash investment in long-lived operating assets.
scope: A common non-GAAP FCF convention; distinguish it from FCFF/FCFE and define included investment.

name: Cash conversion cycle
expression: Inventory days + receivable days − payable days
inputs: Inventory days: stock holding duration.
Receivable days: customer collection duration.
Payable days: supplier payment duration.
scope: Use matching periods and compatible balance/flow definitions. A negative cycle can occur in some business models.

name: Net activity cash flow
expression: Operating + investing + financing cash flows
inputs: Each activity flow: signed cash inflows less cash outflows in that class.
scope: This is the net of activity flows; the total cash reconciliation can also include FX and other required effects.

name: Discounted cash-flow sum
expression: Σ CFₜ / (1 + r)ᵗ
inputs: CFₜ: cash flow at the end of period t.
r: compatible discount rate per period.
t: time periods from the valuation date.
scope: Include time-zero cash separately. Match cash-flow recipients, currency, inflation basis and rate period.

name: Present value of a single cash flow
expression: CF / (1 + r)ⁿ
inputs: CF: future cash amount.
r: discount rate per period.
n: number of matching periods.
scope: Assumes a specified cash-flow timing and rate; noninteger/irregular timing requires an appropriate convention.

name: Future value of a single amount
expression: PV × (1 + r)ⁿ
inputs: PV: starting amount.
r: compound return/interest rate per period.
n: matching compounding periods.
scope: Assumes a constant rate and stated compounding convention; not a guaranteed investment return.

name: Level-cash-flow payback shortcut
expression: Initial investment / annual positive net cash inflow
inputs: Initial investment: initial positive outlay.
Annual cash inflow: constant positive net inflow.
scope: Only for level flows; uneven flows require cumulative cash-flow analysis. Undiscounted payback ignores later cash flows and time value.

name: Operating cash-flow margin
expression: Operating cash flow / net sales
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: OCF: period operating cash flow.
Net sales: matching period sales.
scope: Cash collections and revenue recognition differ; a period margin needs context.

name: Operating-plus-investing net cash flow
expression: Operating cash flow + investing cash flow
inputs: Operating and investing cash flows: signed net flows.
scope: A negative result is cash consumption in this defined scope; positive net burn reverses its sign. Financing is excluded.

name: Free cash flow to the firm: operating-profit bridge
expression: EBIT × (1 − tax rate) + noncash operating charges − CAPEX − increase in noncash operating working capital
inputs: EBIT: compatible operating earnings basis.
Tax rate: operating-tax assumption.
Noncash charges: eligible noncash operating expenses.
scope: The tax/operating basis must be suitable for the model. CAPEX is cash capital expenditure expressed as a positive outflow; ΔNWC is an increase in noncash operating working capital, excluding financing debt. Reconcile classification and other noncash/operating adjustments.

name: Free cash flow to equity: full earnings bridge
expression: Net income + noncash charges − CAPEX − increase in noncash operating working capital + net borrowing
inputs: Net income: earnings after interest and tax.
Net borrowing: new debt proceeds less principal repayments.
Noncash charges: required earnings-to-cash adjustments.
scope: The source’s EBITDA-minus-tax/CAPEX/interest shortcut omits working-capital and net-borrowing effects. CAPEX is cash capital expenditure expressed as a positive outflow; ΔNWC is an increase in noncash operating working capital, excluding financing debt. Reconcile classification and other noncash/operating adjustments.

name: OCF to current liabilities
expression: Operating cash flow / current liabilities
inputs: OCF: period operating cash generation.
Current liabilities: stated closing or average current obligations.
scope: This is coverage of liabilities, not a revenue margin. State balance timing.

name: Receivable days (DSO)
expression: Average trade receivables / net credit sales × period days
inputs: Average receivables: compatible customer balance.
Credit sales: sales creating those receivables.
Period days: actual days for the sales period.
scope: The source abbreviates one entry as DSP; the intended collection-duration measure is DSO.

name: Payable days (DPO)
expression: Average trade payables / credit purchases × period days
inputs: Average payables: matching supplier balance.
Credit purchases: purchases creating those obligations.
Period days: days covered by purchases.
scope: Annual 365-day versions assume annual flows. Disclose use of cost-of-sales proxies.

name: Inventory days (DIO)
expression: Average inventory / cost of goods sold × period days
inputs: Average inventory: compatible stock value.
COGS: stock cost sold in the period.
Period days: days covered by COGS.
scope: Do not mechanically multiply a quarterly-flow ratio by 365.

name: Perpetual-growth terminal value
expression: Next-period sustainable cash flow / (discount rate − long-run growth rate)
inputs: Next-period cash flow: first flow after the explicit forecast.
Discount rate and growth: compatible periodic rates.
scope: Requires discount rate greater than growth and sustainable reinvestment. Discount terminal value back to today.

name: Operating-cash-flow liability coverage
expression: Operating cash flow / current liabilities
inputs: OCF: period operating cash flow.
Current liabilities: declared closing or average short-term obligation base.
scope: Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Cash-flow return on assets
expression: Operating cash flow / average total assets
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: OCF: matching period operating cash flow.
Average assets: compatible asset base.
scope: Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Cash flow to net income
expression: Operating cash flow / net income
inputs: OCF: cash from operations.
Net income: compatible period accounting earnings.
scope: Timing and working-capital changes can drive the ratio; a loss or near-zero income prevents a simple higher-is-better interpretation.

name: Operating cash flow per common share
expression: (Operating cash flow − preferred cash dividends) / weighted-average common shares
inputs: Preferred cash dividends: relevant preference distributions.
Weighted-average common shares: compatible period share count.
scope: A stated cash-per-share convention, not GAAP EPS; define dividends and cash-flow scope.

name: Cash flow to investors: unresolved definition
inputs: FCF: the source does not specify FCFF, FCFE or another convention.
Net debt issued: debt proceeds less repayments under a declared scope.
scope: The title, formula and explanation do not establish compatible cash-flow recipients or financing signs. Do not use the source fraction/bridge without clarifying those definitions.

name: Cash available for debt-service coverage
expression: Cash available for debt service / scheduled principal and interest
inputs: Cash available for debt service: cash before the debt-service payments being tested.
Debt service: principal and interest in the same test period.
scope: OCF is not automatically the correct numerator, especially when interest has already been deducted. Use the applicable agreement.

name: Simple FCF return on invested capital
expression: Free cash flow / invested capital
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: FCF: explicitly defined cash-flow measure.
Invested capital: compatible operating investment base.
scope: The source does not define a complete CFROI methodology; treat this only as the stated simple cash-return fraction.

name: Monthly net cash burn
expression: Included monthly cash outflows − included monthly cash inflows
inputs: Included flows: declared operating/investment cash scope, normally excluding financing.
scope: Positive burn means consumption. Average burn can hide changing timing and large future payments.

name: Average days delinquent
expression: DSO − best-possible DSO
inputs: DSO: actual receivable collection duration.
Best-possible DSO: duration under the stated on-time payment/receivables convention.
scope: Define the same customer/cohort base and terms before comparing the durations.

name: Overdue receivables ratio
expression: Overdue receivables / total relevant receivables
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Overdue receivables: unpaid balances past the agreed due date.
Total receivables: matching customer, currency and date base.
scope: State aging, disputes, credit notes and allowance treatment.

name: Inventory days: annual convention
expression: Average inventory / annual COGS × 365
inputs: Average inventory: stock value for the measured period.
Annual COGS: annual cost of goods sold.
scope: This duplicate annual convention assumes 365 days and annual flow; use the relevant period convention otherwise.

name: Payable days using a COGS proxy
expression: Average trade payables / annual COGS × 365
inputs: Average trade payables: supplier obligation balance.
Annual COGS: disclosed proxy for credit purchases.
scope: The source calls this DSO while describing payment to suppliers. It is a payable-days proxy and can differ from a purchases-based DPO.

name: Cash reserves in days
expression: Available cash reserves / average daily relevant cash expenses
inputs: Available reserves: accessible cash in the defined scope.
Daily cash expenses: forecast/observed cash costs per day.
scope: Restrictions, noncash expenses and uneven payments matter; this is a conditional buffer estimate.

name: Operating cash-flow margin in percent
expression: Operating cash flow / net sales × 100
inputs: OCF: period cash from operations.
Net sales: corresponding recognized sales.
scope: This is the percent form of OCF/sales, not a measure of accounting gross margin.

name: Free-cash-flow margin
expression: Defined free cash flow / net sales × 100
inputs: FCF: the explicitly selected cash-flow convention.
Net sales: matching recognized sales.
scope: The source typo “Neet Sales” is normalized; FCF definitions must remain compatible across comparisons.

name: Cash debt-service coverage: denominator convention
expression: Cash available for debt service / (principal due + interest due)
inputs: Cash available: cash before the tested payments.
Principal/interest: matching scheduled amounts.
scope: Do not subtract interest in the numerator and silently treat that as the same pre-service convention. Contract tests can differ.

name: Sales to working-capital turnover
expression: Net sales / average defined working capital
inputs: Net sales: period sales.
Average working capital: explicitly broad or operating working capital base.
scope: The source calls this cash conversion efficiency and describes days. The displayed fraction is turnover, not a duration.

name: Net income
expression: Recognized revenue and other income − all applicable expenses
inputs: Recognized income: income belonging to the reporting period.
Applicable expenses: costs including relevant financing and tax.
scope: Reconcile to the actual statement and avoid treating cash receipts/payments as equivalent to accrual income/expense.

name: Gross profit
expression: Relevant net sales − cost of goods/services sold
inputs: Relevant net sales: recognized revenue for the activities measured.
Cost of sales: corresponding direct cost under the stated accounting policy.
scope: Use the same activity scope and period; gross profit is an amount, not a percentage.

name: EBITDA: net-income reconciliation
expression: Net income + income tax expense + interest expense + depreciation + amortisation
inputs: Net income: accounting earnings base.
Add-backs: the included interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation expenses.
scope: The source also subtracts interest income; that is a different definition needing explicit reconciliation. Add each eligible item once.

name: Operating profit from gross profit
expression: Gross profit − applicable operating expenses
inputs: Gross profit: profit after matching cost of sales.
Operating expenses: expenses included in the selected operating-profit definition.
scope: Include relevant D&A when calculating EBIT/operating profit. EBIT and operating income are not always identical.

name: Net other income
expression: Other income − other expenses
inputs: Other income/expenses: lines excluded from the stated operating subtotal.
scope: Define the classification and reconcile to the full statement.

name: Net profit margin
expression: Net income / matching revenue
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Net income: corresponding after-expense earnings.
Revenue: matching recognized period revenue.
scope: Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Price-to-earnings
expression: Market price per share / compatible earnings per share
inputs: Share price: stated date/class.
EPS: basic or diluted, trailing or forward, on a declared basis.
scope: A negative/near-zero EPS undermines the usual multiple interpretation.

name: Gross profit margin
expression: Gross profit / matching net sales
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Gross profit: matching revenue less cost of sales.
Net sales: revenue on the same basis.
scope: Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Accounting return on investment
expression: Defined period net profit / defined investment base
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Net profit: profit attributed to the investment.
Investment base: stated initial or average investment convention.
scope: The source’s accounting ratio differs from total investment holding-period return and needs a time horizon.

name: Return on capital employed
expression: Compatible operating profit / stated capital employed
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Operating profit: period earnings on the chosen basis.
Capital employed: stated operating-capital definition and average/closing timing.
scope: Assets less current liabilities and long-term debt plus equity are common starting bases; adjustments and timing must be consistent.

name: Basic earnings per common share
expression: (Attributable net income − applicable preferred dividends) / weighted-average common shares
inputs: Attributable income: earnings matching common owners.
Preferred dividends: applicable preference deduction.
Weighted shares: period common share count.
scope: This simplified basic-EPS bridge is not a diluted-EPS or full participation-rights model.

name: Operating profit margin
expression: Operating profit / matching revenue
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Operating profit: declared operating subtotal.
Revenue: matching period revenue.
scope: Use the same period, currency, accounting perimeter and definition for compared inputs. A zero denominator is undefined; negative bases can change or defeat the usual interpretation. Higher/lower is not an automatic quality score.

name: Dividend yield
expression: Annual dividend per corresponding share / market price per share
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Annual dividend: stated historical/forward convention.
Market price: corresponding class and date.
scope: Not a total return or guaranteed future payout; disclose special-dividend treatment.

name: Gross margin: revenue-cost form
expression: (Revenue − corresponding cost of sales) / revenue
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Revenue/cost of sales: same period and activity scope.
scope: Equivalent to gross profit/revenue when the underlying definitions match.

name: Net Promoter Score
expression: Promoter percentage − detractor percentage
inputs: Promoter percentage: share classified as promoters under the stated survey scale.
Detractor percentage: share classified as detractors on that scale.
scope: The upload supplies the difference but not question wording, rating thresholds, sampling or collection method. NPS is not a financial profit margin.

name: Transfer-pricing operating net margin
expression: Relevant operating net profit / relevant sales
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Operating net profit: result on the tested transaction/entity scope.
Relevant sales: compatible revenue base.
scope: A profit-level indicator is not an automatic arm’s-length result; comparability and tested-party selection matter.

name: Net cost-plus / return on total costs
expression: Relevant operating net profit / relevant operating cost base
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Profit: tested operating result.
Cost base: defined costs relevant to the tested activity.
scope: Pass-through costs and accounting classifications affect comparability. Do not assume every company expense belongs in the denominator.

name: Berry ratio
expression: Relevant gross profit / relevant operating expenses
inputs: Gross profit: tested gross return.
Operating expenses: appropriate operating cost base.
scope: Use only where the functional and comparability assumptions support this indicator; not a universal distributor benchmark.

name: Opening/closing average inventory
expression: (Opening inventory + closing inventory) / 2
inputs: Opening/closing inventory: matching stock definitions.
scope: Two snapshots can miss seasonality; use more observations where needed.

name: Inventory days on hand
expression: Average inventory / period COGS × period days
inputs: Average inventory: relevant stock base.
COGS and days: matched reporting period.
scope: The source uses period COGS but always multiplies by 365. Use matching period days.

name: Stock-to-sales ratio
expression: Stated inventory value / matching sales value
inputs: Inventory: date and valuation basis.
Sales: period and gross/net basis.
scope: Inventory at cost divided by sales at selling prices is a stated operating convention, not a like-cost fraction.

name: Inventory carrying-cost rate
expression: (Service + risk + capital + storage costs) / stated inventory value
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Costs: matching-period costs included in the carrying-cost scope.
Inventory value: declared average/closing valuation base.
scope: State period and avoid double-counting capital/financing/storage costs. Not every cost category is an accounting expense.

name: Source order-backlog rate
expression: Undeliverable orders / total relevant orders
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Undeliverable orders: orders meeting a declared delayed/backordered definition.
Total orders: matching cohort of orders.
scope: Define backordered versus cancelled or otherwise undeliverable orders; do not mix order counts and units.

name: Sell-through on receipts
expression: Units sold / units received
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Units sold/received: same product, period and unit basis.
scope: This source receipts-based convention differs from available-stock measures when opening stock exists.

name: Inventory scrap-cost ratio
expression: Period scrap expense / average inventory value
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Scrap expense: cost written off for scrap in the period.
Average inventory value: compatible stock valuation.
scope: This is a cost/value measure, not scrap units divided by production units.

name: Stock-receiving process time
expression: Validation time + recording time + storage-preparation time
inputs: Component times: non-overlapping elapsed/labour times under one declared convention.
scope: Parallel work and elapsed versus labour time can prevent simple addition unless the process definition supports it.

name: Book-to-physical inventory difference
expression: Book inventory value − physical inventory value
inputs: Book value: ledger stock value.
Physical value: counted stock valued on the same basis.
scope: A negative difference is an overage under this sign convention. A discrepancy alone does not prove fraud.

name: Dead-stock share
expression: Unsellable relevant stock / total relevant available stock
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Numerator/denominator: both units or both values at a matching date and scope.
scope: State obsolescence criteria and snapshot/cohort definitions; do not mix unit and currency bases.

name: Customer churn rate
expression: Opening-cohort customers lost during period / customers at period start
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Customers lost: opening-cohort customers meeting the churn definition.
Opening customers: eligible starting customer base.
scope: The source says total customers without specifying timing. New customers should not silently dilute an opening-cohort loss rate.

name: New-buyer growth
expression: (New buyers this period − new buyers prior period) / new buyers prior period
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: New buyers: distinct buyers meeting the acquisition definition in each comparable period.
scope: Not total-customer growth; prior-period zero makes the rate undefined.

name: Simple revenue lifetime value
expression: Revenue per customer per period × expected customer lifespan in periods
inputs: Period revenue: compatible expected revenue per customer.
Lifespan: expected duration in the same periods.
scope: A constant-average revenue approximation, not profit/contribution LTV, discounted cash value or a guaranteed lifetime.

name: Customer acquisition cost
expression: Attributed sales and marketing cost / matching new customers acquired
inputs: Attributed costs: declared acquisition cost allocation.
New customers: acquisition cohort matching those costs.
scope: Allow for sales-cycle timing and attribution. Revenue growth and customer acquisition are different outcomes.

name: Net cash burn
expression: Included cash outflows − included cash inflows
inputs: Included inflows/outflows: declared cash-flow perimeter.
scope: Positive means consumption. Financing proceeds and one-offs can distort operating runway if mixed without explanation.

name: Constant-burn runway
expression: Available cash / positive net burn per period
inputs: Available cash: spendable cash after any stated minimum reserve.
Net burn: positive compatible cash consumption per period.
scope: Not a finite depletion forecast when burn is zero/negative; changing cash flows require a dated rolling forecast.

name: Revenue per customer
expression: Period revenue / stated matching customer base
inputs: Revenue: defined customer revenue.
Customer base: declared average/active/point-in-time count.
scope: Customer and user counts differ. State period and population; a closing count is not automatically comparable to an average.

name: SaaS quick ratio
expression: (New MRR + expansion MRR) / (churned MRR + contraction MRR)
inputs: New/expansion MRR: additions in normalized monthly recurring value.
Churn/contraction MRR: positive magnitudes of lost recurring value.
scope: The source’s “net MRR” is ambiguous; the displayed convention uses new MRR. Define reactivation policy and avoid confusing this with the financial quick ratio.

name: Uniform-customer MRR shortcut
expression: Eligible customers × average normalized monthly recurring amount
inputs: Customers: eligible active subscriptions/customers.
Monthly amount: recurring charge normalized to a month.
scope: Exclude nonrecurring items and define subscription states; annual billing is not all MRR in the payment month.

name: Contract-value market-size estimate
expression: Annual eligible contract value per client × potential eligible clients
inputs: Annual client value: assumed annual contract amount.
Potential clients: stated target population.
scope: A top-down TAM hypothesis, not serviceable or obtainable market evidence.

name: Net revenue retention for an opening cohort
expression: (Opening-cohort MRR + expansion − contraction − churn) / opening-cohort MRR × 100
inputs: Opening-cohort MRR: recurring value of customers present at start.
Movements: only changes for that cohort, with loss amounts positive.
scope: Exclude new-customer revenue. The source’s “net revenue” does not supply this cohort definition; state reactivation policy.

name: Gross-profit CAC payback
expression: CAC per acquired customer / gross profit per customer per period
inputs: CAC: acquisition cost per new customer.
Gross profit: expected revenue less corresponding cost of sales per customer and period.
scope: The source omits per-customer/per-period matching. A zero/negative gross profit does not provide a positive payback time.

name: Sales quota attainment
expression: Sales on the quota basis / quota on the same basis × 100
inputs: Sales: declared bookings/revenue/unit measure.
Quota: target in the same units and period.
scope: Do not compare monthly recognized revenue to an annual bookings quota.

name: Average annual contract value
expression: Total annualized eligible contract value / eligible contract count
inputs: Annualized value: recurring/eligible contract value normalized to a year.
Contract count: matching eligible contracts.
scope: The source uses total revenue without annualization. Contract value, recognized revenue and one-time fees need separate treatment.

name: Expansion recurring revenue
expression: Sum of positive recurring-value increases for continuing customers
inputs: Expansion movements: customer-level upgrades/additions under a stated policy.
scope: Aggregate period revenue minus reactivation/churn cannot isolate expansion. Define cohort and exclude new/reactivated customer value as appropriate.

name: Contraction recurring revenue
expression: Sum of partial recurring-value reductions for continuing customers
inputs: Contraction movements: positive magnitudes of downgrades/reductions.
scope: Separate partial downgrades from full churn; aggregate revenue totals cannot isolate contraction reliably.

name: Budget attainment versus variance
expression: Attainment = actual / budget; variance rate = (actual − budget) / budget
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Actual/budget: same measure, period, units and perimeter.
scope: The source labels variance/budget as attainment. Favorable/unfavorable signs depend on whether the measure is cost, revenue or another target.

name: Revenue per user
expression: Period revenue / stated matching user base
inputs: Revenue: defined relevant revenue.
Users: eligible user count, with average/active/closing timing declared.
scope: Users, paying accounts and customers are different populations; do not silently interchange ARPU/ARPA definitions.

name: Revenue run-rate annualization
expression: Latest monthly revenue × 12
inputs: Monthly revenue: declared recognized revenue for the selected month.
scope: A snapshot annualization, not ARR or a forecast; seasonality and one-off items can distort it.

name: Forecast cash-depletion date
expression: First forecast date when the cash balance reaches the stated depletion threshold
inputs: Cash forecast: dated expected inflows/outflows.
Threshold: zero cash or a declared minimum liquidity buffer.
scope: “This month + runway” needs actual dates, period conventions and a constant-burn assumption; it is not a complete calendar calculation.

name: Probability-weighted pipeline
expression: Σ (deal valueᵢ × compatible close probabilityᵢ)
inputs: Deal value: compatible amount for each included opportunity.
Probability: declared likelihood between 0 and 1, matched to outcome/time.
scope: A single total-value times probability works only with a compatible weighted probability. Expected pipeline is not recognized revenue or a closing guarantee.

name: Balance-sheet reconciliation identity
expression: Assets = liabilities + equity
inputs: Recognized assets/liabilities/equity: same entity, date and accounting basis.
scope: Balance is necessary but not evidence that all underlying classifications/valuations are correct.

name: Simplified purchase-price allocation bridge
expression: Purchase price = fair value of identifiable net assets + goodwill
inputs: Identifiable net assets: recognized acquired assets less assumed liabilities at the appropriate values.
Goodwill: residual under the applicable acquisition model.
scope: This simplified wholly-owned bridge does not cover NCI, previously held stakes, all deferred-tax effects or every transaction structure.

name: Operating cash flow: reconcile working-capital signs
expression: Net income + signed noncash adjustments − increase in noncash operating working capital + required operating reconciliations
inputs: Noncash adjustments: signed earnings-to-cash adjustments.
Working-capital increase: positive investment in noncash operating balances.
scope: The source adds “changes” without defining their sign. Define investment increases versus signed cash effects explicitly. CAPEX is cash capital expenditure expressed as a positive outflow; ΔNWC is an increase in noncash operating working capital, excluding financing debt. Reconcile classification and other noncash/operating adjustments.

name: Investing cash flow
expression: Cash investing receipts − cash investing payments
inputs: Investing receipts/payments: relevant disposals, acquisitions, lending and investment cash flows.
scope: Net CAPEX is only part of investing cash flow, with a stated sign; the source equates them too broadly.

name: Financing cash flow
expression: Debt proceeds − principal repayments + equity proceeds − share repurchases − distributions + other financing flows
inputs: Debt/equity movements: relevant cash financing receipts and payments.
scope: The source’s “net debt process” appears to mean proceeds. Define distributions, lease/debt repayments and framework-dependent classification.

name: FCFF: operating-cash-flow bridge
expression: Operating cash flow − cash CAPEX + compatible after-tax interest adjustment
inputs: OCF: operating cash flow after the interest deduction being adjusted.
After-tax interest: compatible interest × (1 − tax rate).
scope: Valid only with compatible interest and tax classifications; otherwise use/reconcile an operating-profit bridge.

name: FCFE: operating-cash-flow bridge
expression: Operating cash flow − cash CAPEX + net borrowing
inputs: OCF: compatible after-interest/tax operating cash flow.
Net borrowing: debt proceeds less principal repayment.
scope: Reconcile cash-flow classifications and other required equity-cash adjustments. CAPEX is cash capital expenditure expressed as a positive outflow; ΔNWC is an increase in noncash operating working capital, excluding financing debt. Reconcile classification and other noncash/operating adjustments.

name: EBITDA margin
expression: Defined EBITDA / matching revenue
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: EBITDA: explicitly reconciled earnings measure.
Revenue: same entity and period.
scope: Not a cash-flow margin; comparisons require the same adjustment policy.

name: EBITDA-based interest coverage
expression: EBITDA / compatible interest expense
inputs: EBITDA: declared earnings measure.
Interest expense: matching test period and definition.
scope: Different from EBIT/interest and cash-interest coverage. A covenant may define each input differently.

name: EBITDA-based debt-service proxy
expression: EBITDA / (scheduled principal + compatible interest)
inputs: EBITDA: chosen period earnings measure.
Debt service: matching scheduled principal and interest.
scope: This proxy does not fund taxes, investment or working capital. It is not a universal cash DSCR or agreement test.

name: Fixed-charge coverage: agreement-specific
inputs: Fixed charges, cash taxes, unfunded CAPEX, distributions and P/I: terms requiring their agreement definitions.
scope: The source expression cannot be certified as a universal covenant without the agreement, test period and adjustment rules. Original wording is retained for review.

name: Funded debt to EBITDA
expression: Defined funded debt / compatible EBITDA
inputs: Funded debt: debt included by the chosen convention/agreement.
EBITDA: compatible period earnings.
scope: State leases, guarantees, adjustments, trailing-period basis and negative-EBITDA limitations.

name: Three-factor DuPont identity
expression: ROE = (net income / net sales) × (net sales / average total assets) × (average total assets / average equity)
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Net income/sales: matching period measures.
Average assets/equity: compatible averages and owners.
scope: The source lists many related ratios rather than an algebraic identity. Do not multiply every item in that list.

name: Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation
expression: EBITDA + separately identified signed adjustments
inputs: EBITDA: base measure reconciled to net income.
Signed adjustments: justified additions and deductions under a stated policy.
scope: An item being noncash, recurring, personal or one-time is not automatic permission to exclude it. Reconcile and explain each adjustment.

name: FCFF: correct the fixed-asset shorthand
expression: Operating cash flow + compatible after-tax interest − cash CAPEX
inputs: OCF/interest: compatible classifications.
Cash CAPEX: actual relevant cash investment, not an unexplained change in asset balance.
scope: Changes in fixed assets can include depreciation, disposals and noncash movements; they are not automatically CAPEX.

name: FCFE: use changes, not balance totals
expression: Net income + noncash charges − cash CAPEX − increase in noncash operating working capital + net borrowing
inputs: Working-capital changes: relevant noncash operating balance changes, not sums of their balances.
Net borrowing: new debt less principal repaid.
scope: The source adds receivable, payable, inventory and other balances and CAPEX without a defined reconciliation. CAPEX is cash capital expenditure expressed as a positive outflow; ΔNWC is an increase in noncash operating working capital, excluding financing debt. Reconcile classification and other noncash/operating adjustments.

name: Economic profit / EVA-style measure
expression: After-tax operating profit − (compatible cost of capital × invested capital)
inputs: After-tax operating profit: NOPAT on the model’s tax basis.
Invested capital: defined operating investment base.
Cost of capital: compatible period rate.
scope: Debt plus equity is a simplified base; adjustments and timing must be explicit. This is not a completed proprietary valuation methodology.

name: Two-source WACC
expression: (E / (D + E)) × rE + (D / (D + E)) × rD × (1 − tax rate)
inputs: E/D: compatible equity/debt values or declared target weights.
rE: cost of equity.
rD: pretax cost of debt.
Tax rate: usable debt-tax-shield assumption.
scope: Match cash flow, currency, rate horizon and capital structure. Financing beyond debt/equity and unusable tax shields need additional treatment.

name: Return on invested capital
expression: After-tax operating profit / average defined operating invested capital
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: After-tax operating profit: matching NOPAT.
Average invested capital: compatible operating-capital base.
scope: The source’s long-term-debt plus equity minus cash is a shortcut. Separate operating cash needs, other financing and averages before comparing.

name: Dividend payout ratio
expression: Corresponding dividends / corresponding earnings
units: ratio; multiply by 100 to express a percentage
inputs: Dividends/earnings: matched common or total-owner basis and period.
scope: Losses, preference distributions and one-off dividends can make simple comparisons misleading.

name: EBITDA bridge: complete the split source line
expression: Net income + interest expense + income tax expense + depreciation + amortisation
inputs: Net income: accounting earnings base.
Add-backs: eligible included expenses, each counted once.
scope: The source line continues in the next paragraph. Its earlier sequence excludes D&A and then adds it again; add it back only if already expensed in the starting subtotal.

name: CAPM cost of equity
expression: Risk-free rate + equity beta × (expected market return − risk-free rate)
inputs: Risk-free rate: compatible currency/horizon assumption.
Equity beta: equity-risk estimate.
Expected market return: market return assumption.
scope: This is a cost-of-equity model, not a universal discount rate. FCFF and FCFE require matched discount rates and cash definitions.

name: Annual recurring revenue
expression: Normalized eligible MRR × 12
inputs: MRR: eligible recurring revenue normalized to a month at the measurement date.
scope: ARR is an annualization of a recurring base, not recognized annual revenue, annual cash receipts or a guaranteed forecast.

name: MRR movement bridge
expression: Opening MRR + new MRR + expansion MRR − churned MRR − contraction MRR
inputs: Opening MRR: starting recurring base.
Movements: normalized recurring-value changes on a consistent customer policy.
scope: Bookings must be normalized to eligible recurring monthly value; define reactivation treatment separately and reconcile it consistently.

name: Sales-capacity forecast shortcut
inputs: Required definitions: productive rep capacity, ramp treatment, quota period, expected attainment and timing.
scope: Reps × ramp period × quota does not establish a compatible revenue model. The source supplies no complete units or inputs; do not treat it as executable.

name: Ad-spend forecast shortcut
inputs: Required definitions: spend-to-lead/traffic conversion, cost per lead/click, customer conversion, customer value and timing.
scope: Ad spend × conversion rate alone does not establish new sales revenue. Missing drivers must be defined rather than filled with invented values.

name: Partner-referral driver
expression: Active partners × referrals per active partner per month
inputs: Active partners: partners generating referrals.
Referral rate: expected relevant referrals per partner per month.
scope: This estimates referrals, not sales or revenue. Conversion, contract value and timing are separate missing drivers.
